name: Hangzhou Youngsun Intelligent Equipment Co., Ltd.
summary: Hangzhou Youngsun Intelligent Equipment Co., Ltd. engages in research and development, production and sales of packaging equipment and supporting packaging materials internationally. The company offers vacuum packaging machines, labeling machines, shrink wrappers, carton sealers, box sealing machines, blister packaging machines, strapping machines, battery strapping tools, strapping tools, palletizers, wrapping machines, depalletizing, carton packers, packing lines, PP/PET straps, stretch films/shrink films, conveyors, cartoning machines, robots, vertical packaging machines, tea/coffee bag VFFS machines, filling and capping machines, can filler seamer machines, full automatic can unloaders, …
